anti_drift_guards.reject: Treating softbook_cet as a generic English teaching system.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Restate that cards serve CET4/CET6 exam preparation through low-burden micro-coaching and box-owned knowledge points.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Reducing the product to a vocabulary memorization tool.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Require library/group/box ownership and exam-useful analysis beyond word meaning.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Making true-exam source the only formal quality criterion.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: True exam is a high-quality source and calibration reference; generated, simulated, or original material can become formal only after exact-scope model acceptance and required deterministic checks.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Passing a batch because fields validate while content quality is weak.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Run content-quality blockers, scorecard, semantic model review, and current authorization validation; structural validation alone is not acceptance.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Batch-generating without exact-scope semantic review and measurable quality checks.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: The model may generate the complete authorized scope, but current authorization requires exact-input model evidence, audit replay, and zero blocking findings without a person checkpoint.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Agent claims content is usable without current model evidence or required gates.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: The model-and-harness system may authorize formal use when model-acceptance.v2 and every required deterministic gate bind the same immutable input.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Treating TTS audio as non-AI or as source evidence.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Keep text source type separate from audio generation method; TTS audio is AI generated from reviewed text.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Treating chat text or PR status as enough to authorize content without linked semantic evidence.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Require a scoped model review with quality metadata, blocker scan, exact input hash, structured findings, and current authorization evidence.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Treating an existing ai_tts path or generated MP3 file as formal audio readiness.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Require the audio generation contract, text gate, per-card audio QC record, and explicit boundary that TTS audio is not source authenticity evidence.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Trusting declared review scope or legacy status to avoid validating the complete current card object and its self-review metadata snapshot.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Derive changed cards from merge-base to head, require current complete metadata, and compare every metadata field except the independently validated artifact-local review_status.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Treating a shaped or downgraded patch hash, partial or ill-typed record, overwritten historical handoff, non-regular or disguised handoff object, replace-ref/grafts-shaped history, transient pre-payload path, incomplete touched_paths list, unbound PR locator, compare URL, stale push ref, or stale ancestor commit as proof that a handoff can recover the complete PR payload.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Exclude only the exact handoff template path; enforce the complete typed template schema and change-type/merge-authority consistency; fatally and byte-preservingly decode Git path bytes as UTF-8 including a leading U+FEFF filename character; require one append-only direct safe non-executable 100644 JSON blob at the fixed PR-head tree, preserve every historical handoff, and read the current record by exact ls-tree plus cat-file object ID; resolve base, head, and payload commit to fixed OIDs under one canonical GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS and GIT_GRAFT_FILE-null environment; reject symlinks, executable blobs, gitlinks, nested/control/Unicode-line-separator paths, Git replace refs, GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, non-empty common-dir info/grafts including linked worktrees, legacy hashes, and missing v2 fields; force --ignore-submodules=none and --no-ext-diff during every path walk; recompute mandatory git-diff-binary-v2 with the authority-declared deterministic environment/config/options and commit-sourced attributes; fail closed on repository info attributes or custom diff-driver config; bind the exact payload path set to the final payload commit; inspect the full reachable pre- and post-payload commit sets including merged side histories so add-delete, modify-restore, non-UTF-8, gitlink, reverted mutation, or identical-tree merge paths still fail; require exact pull-request event number/URL/state/draft/head/base/repository binding for real PRs; and require parked compare remote-tracking refs to equal the explicit head.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Allowing a noncanonical card_boxes_json path, unprefixed or template-suffix-disguised governed review path, partial or wrong-track aggregate coverage, full-track remediation coverage for a card absent from merge-base, self-review-only edit, partial base-to-HEAD audit overlay, or legacy text/is_correct shape to bypass the current candidate contract.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Govern every consumed card-box and review path, exclude only exact repository-declared template paths, compare every changed standard self-review entry with its unique HEAD corpus card, count full-track aggregate evidence only when strict internal scope/coverage equals the complete declared track in immutable HEAD and the non-empty track ID set is unchanged from merge-base, materialize the complete immutable HEAD card tree for scoped audit replay, and require explicit runtime IDs on any changed elimination candidate while grandfathering untouched legacy migrations only.

anti_drift_guards.reject: Counting a semantically incomplete, automation-reviewed, nested, symlinked, unusually encoded, current-corpus-drifted, or archived-global-audit-reusing self-review artifact as changed-card coverage; accepting an empty, forged, deleted, renamed, or non-replayed scoped-audit artifact merely because it is unlinked; swapping, truncating, or symlinking standard/full-track authority templates; accepting formal approval with an empty timestamp, summary, scope, or representative evidence; mutating the pre-cutover archive index or one of its named records; forcing unrelated historical scoped reports to refresh whenever the corpus fingerprint changes; or letting candidate-queue or release-gap consumers count templates, traversal, symlinks, incomplete records, historical approvals, dirty/staged/mode-drifted audit authority or approval/review/audit evidence, concurrent HEAD/index/file/corpus drift, forged current-digest audits, stale audits, or stale linked self-reviews as current authorization.
anti_drift_guards.recovery: Require the complete canonical review and authorization shape before coverage can count; bind exact scope, immutable input hash, current corpus fingerprint, scoped-audit replay, model identity, two distinct high-risk run IDs, non-empty summary, structured findings, and required capabilities. Preserve Git paths exactly; reject unsafe paths, non-regular files, stale or forged evidence, dirty authority inputs, incomplete coverage, and any generated or simulated content presented as true exam material.
